# OfMe

> OfMe is an on-demand photography app by Beame Technologies LLC. Customers book a photographer who comes to their location for a short session. Photos are taken in the app and delivered to the customer's private in-app album, and photographers never receive or keep copies.

## About

Sessions run from 5 minutes to an hour, priced $9.99 to $64.99. Requesting one specific photographer by name costs 1.5 times the list price. Payment is by card, authorized at booking and captured on delivery. Tips are optional and go entirely to the photographer. OfMe is coming to the App Store and is not open for bookings yet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ofmephotos.com/): What OfMe is and how a session works.
- [Support](https://ofmephotos.com/support.html): How to get help, FAQ on booking, cancellations, photos, payments and refunds, and how to report a safety concern.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ofmephotos.com/privacy.html): What is collected, why, how long it is kept, and user rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://ofmephotos.com/terms.html): Bookings, payments, cancellations, photo rights, and conduct.
- [Delete your account](https://ofmephotos.com/delete-account.html): Deleting an account and personal data in the app, what is removed, and what is retained.

## Contact

- Support email: support@ofmephotos.com
- In-app support: the "Get help" screen on the Profile tab, which opens a support ticket.
